paragraphs.text: Lena , Selfless Champion is a legendary human knight from an unknown plane .

Lena is a hero of the people, a knight who has abandoned her position of power and prestige to lead the common folk in rebellion against a tyrannical royal house. Her own dedication and unimpeachable virtue inspire others and rally soldiers to her cause. All who march under her command know that she would give her life to protect them.
